# `scope_move_left_by_angle`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Start a mount move by an angle to the left, run by a named worker.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x7d260 (64-bit build), MoveByAngleFunc @0x6b080, movement watcher CheckMoveThr @0x1f7be0 |

With a connected mount, the handler checks the mount is not moving (203) and can move (210), then requires an integer degree ({degree} or [degree]; missing or non-integer gives 104). It stores move type 4 with that angle, clears the elapsed-angle counter, starts the movement watcher with the MoveByAngle worker and replies 0 (or the thread-start error). The worker reports through MoveByAngle events (start, moving with value, complete or fail; no error or code). Without a connected mount degree is ignored: the call replies 315, unless the manual parameter (key or first position) is the string manual, in which case it emits MoveByAngle complete at once and replies 0 (INFERRED: a test or simulation hook). Served by the guider process (TCP 4400); a client on the main command port reaches it through the imager unknown-method relay, which is unavailable to guest-table clients. The native-handler grade below does not describe the relay. Mount serial: runs on a worker; its commands were not traced (unresolved).

Side effects: Starts a worker thread, commands physical mount motion and emits MoveByAngle notifications.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |
| 315 | No mount is connected and manual is not the string manual | `mount is not connected` |
| 203 | The mount is already moving (checked first) | `equipment is moving` |
| 210 | The mount driver has no motion capability | `not supported` |
| 104 | Connected mount and degree missing or not an integer | `expected int param` |

A failure to start the worker thread replies with the thread error code; those codes are not exhausted by this table.

## Example

Request, object-form:

```json
{"id":14,"method":"scope_move_left_by_angle","params":{"degree":10}}
```

Request, array-form:

```json
{"id":15,"method":"scope_move_left_by_angle","params":[10]}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_move_left_by_angle","result":0,"code":0,"id":14}
```

Reply, err-203:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_move_left_by_angle","error":"equipment is moving","code":203,"id":16}
```
